children: OREXO AB: OREXO ANNOUNCES FDA ACCEPTANCE OF INVESTIGATIONAL NEW DRUG (IND) APPLICATION FOR OX640 FOR THE TREATMENT OF ANAPHYLAXIS
FIRST PIVOTAL STUDY PLANNED FOR Q4 2026, WITH REGULATORY SUBMISSION TARGETED FOR 2028
CONTINUING ITS ONGOING ACTIVITIES TO IDENTIFY A PARTNER FOR FURTHER DEVELOPMENT AND COMMERCIALIZATION OF OX640
OX640 NDA IS EXPECTED TO BE READY IN 2028 FOR REGULATORY SUBMISSION
